name: Takeshiba Merumo
source: 10 year old 5th grade elementary school class president of [url=http://vndb.org/c14784]Popuri's[/url] class. Since she's class president she's chosen by Popuri to demonstrate sex for the class. She's easily embarrassed and doesn't want to have sex in front of the class so Popuri threatens her to get her to comply. Eventually she comes to enjoy it though.
